test_title: PYST 14: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six players, Aravind, Biswanth, Karun, Dilip, Jayanth and Manohar, are sitting in two rows, three in each row. Jayanth is not at the end of any row. Dilip is second to the left of Manohar. Karun, the neighbour of Jayanth, is sitting diagonally opposite to Dilip. Biswanth is the neighbour of Manohar. After interchanging Dilip with Jayanth, who will be the neighbour(s) of Dilip in the new position?
solution:
According to the question,

1) Dilip is second to the left of Manohar and Karun is sitting diagonally to Dilip.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8400f765d8b981f5f7af98aeaf70dbced39f12080f6c0c6fbfb3b7eaff67ce15.png] .

2) Jayanth is not at the end of any row the neighbour of Karun means Jayanth sitting in the middle of the row and Biswanth is the neighbour of Manohar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c548d3ec31a0e5714eee6efe72c6b9212ea12a5a8ddd99a29cd94b72d52bc06.png] 

3) After interchanging the position of Dilip with Jayanth the arrangement is as follow-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ba94d7c9eec367ae7e9a512506ea5485eb42c54c078b34512d8d62e2bc33cdc.png] 

Arvind and Karun are the neighbours of Dilip.

Hence,** Option (1) **is the answer.
